## L-1001

2006; Seattle; ONE/Northwest; [S009](#s009).

Scope: `specific`. Confidence: `observed`. Status: `active`.

Topic: `conference-data-table`. Disposition: `placed: conference-data-table`.

Plone Conference 2006 ran three conference days in late October 2006 with about 350 attendees from 35 U.S. states and 20 countries, preceded by two days of training for over 110 students and followed by a two-day sprint with about 50 participants.

Locator: Overview.

(l-1011)=

## L-1011

2006; Seattle; ONE/Northwest; [S009](#s009).

Scope: `specific`. Confidence: `observed`. Status: `active`.

Topic: `master-timeline`. Disposition: `placed: master-timeline#case-notes`.

Seattle ran from first idea to conference in about six months: venue reserved in mid-May, community survey in late May, bid and Foundation award in early June, program committee and first sponsors in June, registration open in mid-July, a three-week call for proposals, sessions selected in mid-August, catering and video arranged in early September, print in early October, and session videos delivered about seven weeks after the event.

Locator: Master Timeline.

(l-3006)=

## L-3006

Scope: `general`. Confidence: `observed`. Status: `active`.

Topic: `finance`. Disposition: `placed: finance#how-to`.

Save or scan every receipt from the first day, choose one method and keep to it, and reconcile receipts against card and bank statements on a fixed rhythm (the 2011 team did it every two weeks). Even so, the organizer suspected something was missed.

Locator: Budget, Reimbursement.

(l-3007)=

## L-3007

Scope: `general`. Confidence: `observed`. Status: `active`.

Topic: `finance`. Disposition: `placed: finance#principles-and-general-lessons`.

The biggest bills arrive at the end: catering is charged on the day of service, and last-minute equipment and network rentals pile up. Plan for a large block of payments and ample credit or cash in the final week and the conference week.

Locator: Budget, How much credit do I need?.

Locator: Budget, How much credit do I need?.

Per the 2011 wiki (as of 2011): 16 free tickets (8 to volunteers), 103 early-bird, 30 speaker, 7 student, 104 full-price and 5 other tickets, for USD 76,050 in ticket income. The Budget page rounds ticket income to USD 79K, so the two pages disagree slightly.

Topic: `ticketing-and-registration`. Disposition: `placed: ticketing-and-registration#decisions-you-must-make`.

Publish no refunds and no transfers, but allow a few transfers for extreme cases at the organizers' discretion. The 2011 organizer recommended keeping this policy because an open policy could get out of control.

Locator: Tickets, Pricepoints.

(l-3017)=

## L-3017

2011; San Francisco; Plone Conference 2011 organizing team; [S024](#s024).

Scope: `specific`. Confidence: `observed`. Status: `active`.

Topic: `ticketing-and-registration`. Disposition: `placed: ticketing-and-registration#case-notes`.

In 2011 the team compared three ticketing services and chose the cheapest one with a usable API, connected to a merchant account; it saved building a front end. Trainers used a different service for their training fees.

Locator: Tickets, Software.

(l-3018)=

## L-3018

2011; San Francisco; Plone Conference 2011 organizing team; [S024](#s024).

Locator: Tickets, Software.

(l-3019)=

Locator: Tickets, Software.

## L-3027

(l-3028)=

## L-3028

2011; San Francisco; Plone Conference 2011 organizing team; [S025](#s025).

(l-3029)=

## L-3029

2011; San Francisco; Plone Conference 2011 organizing team; [S025](#s025).

Scope: `general`. Confidence: `observed`. Status: `active`.

Topic: `volunteers-and-roles`. Disposition: `placed: volunteers-and-roles#how-to`.

Staff at least two volunteers per room or track and two at the registration desk all day, dedicated for the whole conference, with half of them also available beforehand for loading and setup. There is no such thing as too many volunteers.

Locator: Managing Volunteers.

## L-3031

2011; San Francisco; Plone Conference 2011 organizing team; [S025](#s025).

(l-6001)=

## L-6001

2026; Maastricht; Plone Conference 2026 organizing team; [S110](#s110).

Scope: `general`. Confidence: `observed`. Status: `active`.

Topic: `survey-template`. Disposition: `placed: survey-template`.

The attendee survey can run as a simple web form on the community site whose submissions arrive as individual emails. That is enough to collect structured ratings and free text, but it leaves every submission as a private message that must be extracted before analysis.

Locator: Header bullets (Source, Method); Appendix — method, reproducibility, privacy.

(l-6002)=

## L-6002

2026; Maastricht; Plone Conference 2026 organizing team; [S110](#s110).

Scope: `general`. Confidence: `observed`. Status: `active`.

Topic: `defining-success`. Disposition: `placed: defining-success#how-to`.

Expect a post-conference survey to reach roughly one in five ticket holders; in 2026 it drew 21 responses over about three weeks. Plan the success metrics so that a response rate of that size can still answer them.

Locator: Header bullet: Response rate; ticket total generalized.

(l-6003)=

## L-6003

2026; Maastricht; Plone Conference 2026 organizing team; [S110](#s110).

Scope: `general`. Confidence: `observed`. Status: `active`.

Topic: `survey-template`. Disposition: `placed: survey-template`.

Extract every submission into structured data with a deterministic script and compute all ratings and counts with a second script. Every number in the published analysis is then reproducible from the raw submissions, and a reviewer can rerun it instead of trusting a hand tally.

Locator: Header bullet: Method; Appendix — Reproduction (method scripts not copied, see S110 manifest note).

(l-6004)=

## L-6004

2026; Maastricht; Plone Conference 2026 organizing team; [S110](#s110).

Scope: `general`. Confidence: `observed`. Status: `active`.

Topic: `handover-contract`. Disposition: `placed: handover-contract#how-to`.

Hand over the survey as an anonymized analysis with respondents numbered rather than named, while the raw submissions stay private, excluded from version control and never committed. Quoted free text can still re-identify respondents to insiders, so no sanitized raw dataset is published either.

Locator: Opening paragraph; Appendix — Raw data and Reproduction.

(l-6005)=

## L-6005

2026; Maastricht; Plone Conference 2026 organizing team; [S110](#s110).

Locator: Appendix — last bullet (red-team review rounds).
